description: Header file defining classes for F1 Application Protocol (F1AP) DU Bearer implementations, including handling of SDUs, PDUs, and notifications for specific radio bearers in a 5G network context.

classes.name: f1c_srb0_du_bearer
classes.description: Final class implementing a specific DU bearer for SRB0, handling UL RRC message transfer and notifications.

classes.name: f1c_other_srb_du_bearer
classes.description: Final class implementing a DU bearer for other SRBs, managing PDU handling, notifications, and RRC delivery reports.

methods.name: handle_sdu
methods.description: Handles the SDU (Service Data Unit) for UL RRC message transfer, packaging and forwarding as per 3GPP specifications.

methods.name: handle_transmit_notification
methods.description: Handles notification for the highest PDCP SN transmitted.

methods.name: handle_delivery_notification
methods.description: Handles notification for the highest PDCP SN delivered.

methods.name: handle_pdu
methods.description: Processes incoming PDU (Protocol Data Unit), with optional RRC delivery status request.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_delivery
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for delivery confirmation within a specified timeout.

methods.name: handle_pdu_and_await_transmission
methods.description: Handles PDU and waits for transmission confirmation within a specified timeout.

methods.name: handle_rrc_delivery_report
methods.description: Processes RRC delivery reports as per 3GPP TS 38.473, section 8.4.4.
